text:
Alex Chen: Heads-up: quick huddle re: inference-efficiency advice roadmap. Customer asks piling up; want to align scope before a mono-sprint.
Mira Patel: On it. Can we focus one deliverable that covers both batching recommendations + a simple quant guide? Customers keep asking 'how much perf vs. quality' — they want clear tradeoffs.
Samir Gupta: Agree. Also need eval-triggered alerts gating for regressions. If a prompt set drops >X% we notify and provide rollback hints.
Kevin Lopez: We should avoid heavy infra lift at GA. MVP = 1) actionable config UI 2) curated quant profiles 3) lightweight eval-alerts (threshold-only) 4) per-route econ hints (est. token $ delta).
Alex Chen: Propose launch criteria: docs + how-to, 2 customer pilots, <10% ops overhead, dashboard showing per-route cost impact. Thoughts? @Mira
Mira Patel: Add acceptance: pilots must supply sample prompts and we run baseline evals. Rollout plan: opt-in beta on Hosted first, then Dedicated with different defaults.
Samir Gupta: OpsBot — any constraints re: telemetry retention/compute for evals? We can't re-run huge evals per commit.
OpsBot: note: baseline eval runs cost ~250 GPU-min for 10k prompts on an A5000 class node; recommend sample-based checks and scheduled nightly/weekly runs.
Kevin Lopez: If cost is high, do stratified sampling + incremental evaluation. Also suggest synthetic perturbations to catch edge-case drift.
Mira Patel: Customer asks: per-customer quant guidance and clear rollback path. We'll need per-model quant profiles + canary config + automatic fallback to fp32 or previous variant.
Alex Chen: For prioritization, rank features: 1) concise batching playbook (hosted + dedicated) 2) quantization cookbook & profiles 3) eval-triggered alerts 4) UI econ hints & rollout copy 5) auto-suggested batch sizes. Vote?
Samir Gupta: Stars on 1,2,3. Beta customers: StoriCorp and FrescoAI volunteered to pilot.
Mira Patel: Timeline sketch: 6w alpha docs + 4w pilot + 2w hardening => ~12 weeks to GA. Resource ask: 1 PM, 2 Eng, 0.5 SRE, 0.5 DataSci.
Kevin Lopez: Ops asks: runbooks for quant fallback, cost-quota gating, and a canary/rollback recipe. Note: Dedicated customers may need stricter defaults and opt-in.
Alex Chen: Action items: Mira to draft acceptance criteria + pilot plan by EOW; Samir to scope eval infra cost + sampling approach; Kevin to prototype UI copy and econ hints.
Samir Gupta: Ack. Quick sampling sketch pasted below:
```
# stratified eval outline
- sample per-route 500 prompts (stratified by length & model variant)
- compute delta on 3 metrics: latency (p50/p95), per-token cost, quality (task metric)
- alert if quality drop >3% OR cost increase >20%
```
Mira Patel: Nice. Also drafting a customer comms template: short blurb, expected impact, instructions to opt-in/opt-out, and rollback contact.
Kevin Lopez: :thumbsup: Keep beta small and documented. Alex, can you schedule a 30m sync tomorrow?
Product-Bot: Reminder: add ticket to board under OPT-1751 (inference-advice): 'beta pilot onboarding'
Alex Chen: Thanks all — closing thread for now, we'll review EOW.
